extraction.name: Common Corpus
extraction.description: Common Corpus is a large-scale, open dataset for language model pre-training containing approximately two trillion tokens. The dataset consists of uncopyrighted or permissively licensed data and includes a wide variety of languages, domains, time periods, and code data.
extraction.license: Public Domain, CC-By, MIT, CC-By-SA, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0
extraction.creator: Pierre-Carl Langlais, Carlos Rosas Hinostroza, Mattia Nee, Catherine Amett, Pavel Chizhov, Eliot Krzystof Jones, Irène Girard, David Mach, Anastasia Stasenko, Ivan P. Yamshchikov
extraction.inLanguage: en, fr, de, es, la, it, pl, el, pt, ru
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by aggregating data from various existing open data initiatives, public domain sources, and government portals through raw text dumps, API access, and web retrieval, which were then post-processed and filtered.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data comprises uncopyrighted or permissively licensed text, including digitized books, historical newspapers, legal documents, patents, and code data across a wide variety of languages.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The dataset collection has been an ongoing effort since 2024. The underlying source documents span various historical periods (e.g., 1618-1990 for Europeana, 2019-2022 for USPTO).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has shallow representation and coverage for low-resource languages.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset does not capture all available open data, is limited in size making it only suitable for pre-training limited-size models, is not suitable for task-specific fine-tuning, and contains curation imperfections such as OCR errors.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset provides a legally compliant, open infrastructure for LLM research, serving the public interest and protecting developers from legal challenges and takedowns associated with copyrighted web data.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for language model pre-training. It is not recommended for instruction-tuning or task-specific fine-tuning.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset has versioning and is actively being expanded with ongoing data collection efforts for European and African languages.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset underwent post-processing and filtering to prepare the text.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Common Corpus1, the largest open dataset for language model pre-training.

description.evidence: The data assembled in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under permissible licenses and amount to about two trillion tokens. The dataset contains a wide variety of languages, ranging from the main European languages to low-resource ones rarely present in pre-training datasets; in addition, it includes a large portion of code data.
